title: It Ends with Us
description: Lily hasn't always had it easy, but that's never stopped her from working hard for the life she wants. When she falls for gorgeous neurosurgeon Ryle Kincaid, everything seems too good to be true until sudden questions arise about love, boundaries, and breaking generational cycles.

title: It Starts with Us
description: Before It Ends with Us, it started with Atlas. Picking up right after the epilogue of It Ends with Us, Colleen Hoover explores the poignant perspectives of Lily and Atlas as they embrace a second chance at true love amid challenging co-parenting dynamics.

title: The Love Hypothesis
description: As a third-year Ph.D. candidate, Olive Smith doesn't believe in lasting romantic relationships. In a panic to convince her best friend that she is dating, she kisses the first man she sees: Adam Carlsen, a notoriously tyrannical young biology professor.

title: Book Lovers
description: Nora Stephens is a fierce literary agent who lives for books and deals. Charlie Lastra is a hypercritical book editor who has rejected her authors. When both end up in the tiny mountain town of Sunshine Falls, North Carolina for the summer, an unexpected rivalry turns into genuine romance.

title: Beach Read
description: A romance writer who no longer believes in love and a literary novelist stuck in a rut spend the summer as neighboring beach house tenants. To conquer writer's block, they make a pact to swap genres: he'll write a happy romance, and she'll write the next Great American Novel.

title: Red, White & Royal Blue
description: What happens when America's First Son Alex Claremont-Diaz falls in love with the Prince of Wales? A staged photo-op truce between rival dignitaries transforms into a secret, high-stakes international romance that could upend presidential politics and the British crown.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
description: Aging and reclusive Hollywood movie icon Evelyn Hugo is finally ready to tell the truth about her glamorous and scandalous life. Summoning unknown magazine reporter Monique Grant, Evelyn reveals the ruthlessness of Old Hollywood and the one unforgettable true love of her life.

title: The Book Thief
description: Narrated by Death in 1939 Nazi Germany, young Liesel Meminger is a foster girl living outside Munich who scratches out a meager existence by stealing books and sharing them with her neighbors and the hidden Jewish fist fighter concealed in her basement.

title: All the Light We Cannot See
description: Winner of the Pulitzer Prize. In occupied France during World War II, a blind French girl and an orphaned German radio prodigy find their lives intertwined in the walled citadel of Saint-Malo as the Allies close in.

title: Pachinko
description: An epic historical saga following four generations of a Korean immigrant family fighting for dignity and belonging in 20th-century Japan. From poverty and discrimination to thriving pachinko parlors, Min Jin Lee weaves an unforgettable portrait of endurance.

title: Where the Crawdads Sing
description: For years, rumors of the 'Marsh Girl' have haunted the coastal North Carolina town of Barkley Cove. When handsome Chase Andrews is found dead in 1969, the locals immediately suspect Kya Clark, an abandoned barefoot girl who grew up wild in the marshes.

title: Daisy Jones & The Six
description: A gripping oral history tracking the rise and fall of a legendary 1970s rock band fronted by charismatic Daisy Jones and brooding Billy Dunne. Behind the sold-out stadiums and platinum albums lay fierce artistic rivalry, desire, and secrets.
